question: Independently certify the degree-24 singular orbit and test the canonical discriminant quadratic cover on retained R17 fibres.
irreducibility: Intersect all possible proper rational factor degrees allowed by squarefree finite-field factorization patterns; stop when the set is empty. If it stays nonempty, independent irreducibility remains UNKNOWN.
retrospective_parameters: Exactly the five fibres in the frozen branch-block input and the two published-R17 entries in the frozen six-pair control source.
gate: Compute the exact rational value of the original surface discriminant at each retained parameter. A nonsquare excludes a rational lift to v^2=Delta(u); it is not a bound on the fibre rank.
boundary: The discriminant cover is a coefficient-defined Galois-sign construction. Parameter tests are retrospective and never candidate generation.
